notes.subject: מלככם
notes.rationale: 'Jahve your Elohim was/is your king' — past (KJV) vs present rebuke (YL T 'is your king'); avañeʼẽ uses present with ningo

notes.subject: mburuvicha
notes.rationale: מלך rendered mburuvicha (chief/ruler), the standard avañeʼẽ office term

notes.subject: מלך/ימלך/מלככם
notes.rationale: Threefold root מלך repetition — man's king vs YHWH as king — preserved by repeating mburuvicha

notes.subject: כי (first)
notes.rationale: 'that/when' conjunction folded into mbaʼéichapa; Hebrew discourse marker has no standalone avañeʼẽ form

notes.subject: Jisrael
notes.rationale: Samuel addresses Israel directly, second person plural throughout (pe-…)
